name: Refactor Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Refactor Capital (refactor.com; site footer '© Refactor Capital 2026'), the seed-stage hard-tech firm run as a solo GP by founding partner Zal Bilimoria (ex-a16z), office at 330 Primrose Road, Burlingame, CA. SEC EDGAR lists Refactor Capital, L.P. and Refactor Capital II-V, L.P. (Delaware, business location Burlingame, CA). Not Refactor (the code-refactoring software term) and not unrelated 'Refactor' consultancies.

thesis_text.value: Seed-stage hard-tech firm run by solo GP Zal Bilimoria, writing $1-2M checks and usually leading or co-leading pre-seed and seed rounds for US founders building physical-world companies in aerospace, energy and nuclear, bio and health, defense, advanced manufacturing and critical materials. Holds fund size near $50M and concentrates each fund in about 20-25 companies.

values: 2026-05-07: refactor.com/posts index date for 'Announcing Refactor 5' and the Form D filing date for Refactor Capital V, L.P.
2026-06-04: byline on the post page itself (the same 'June 4, 2026' byline also appears on the Hexium, Causal Labs and TBC posts, which the index dates to 2025-2026)
January 2026: Portal Tela (2026-05-08) says the fund was raised in January through five calls with existing LPs
conflicts.reason: The index date matches the SEC Form D date; the June 4 byline repeats across older posts and looks like a site re-publish date. January 2026 may be when commitments were secured, not the announcement.

conflicts.reason: Press and the SEC filing agree; CB Insights is a database hint only.
The 2016 articles give the target; the 2024 TechCrunch article states $50M was raised and the founder says he raises '$50M funds like clockwork'.

values: $9.5M seed plus $2.5M credit facility, led by MaC Venture Capital and Refactor (TechCrunch, 2025-04-15)
$8M seed co-led by MaC and Refactor plus $4M mostly non-dilutive financing, $12M total (Power Technology, 2025-04-15)
'In 2024, Refactor co-led the Seed round into Hexium, a $12M round alongside MaC Venture Capital' (Refactor post)
conflicts.reason: TechCrunch gives the equity seed separately from debt; $12M is the total including debt/non-dilutive money. Public announcement date is 2025-04-15; Refactor's '2024' likely reflects when it committed.

open_items: Fund III ($50M, 2021-06-03) rests on CB Insights (database) plus EDGAR filing dates (Form D 2021-02-01, D/A 2021-06-02); the Trusted Insight article citing Insider failed to load (expired certificate), so no press page confirmed the size.

www.sec.gov refused the 'CapitalAtlas research' User-Agent (403), so Form D amounts for Refactor Capital I-V were not read; only EDGAR full-text search and the data.sec.gov submissions record were used.
Fund I close date: the lead's 2016-05-10 was not verified; Axios's launch article returned 403. Recorded as year 2016 (Form D filed 2016-03-22).

Other vehicles not recorded as funds: Refactor Crypto, L.P. (Form D 2018-12-31, EDGAR); CB Insights lists Refactor Sugar ($2.51M, 2020-04-21) and Refactor Ivy (2020-04-02), likely SPVs. The firm says AUM is $300M across five funds and multiple SPVs.
Founding year differs: refactor.com says 'since 2015' (About: founded 2015 as an a16z spinout); press and CB Insights say launched 2016.
invests_in_indian_founders: not stated; the home page says 'across the US'. requires_us_entity: not stated anywhere fetched.

Former team: David Lee (co-founding GP, stepped back in 2019 to chairman per Crunchbase News) and Rick Barber (cofounder per 2016 TechCrunch) are not on the current site; only Zal Bilimoria is listed.
Brelle (Los Angeles battery systems; Refactor post 2026-10-09 says Refactor is backing it alongside Timescale): round amount, stage and date not found.
TBC pre-seed: Refactor says it led TBC's pre-seed and wrote the first institutional check; date and amount not found.
Onyx Bio $8M seed (announced Oct 2026, led by Dimension Capital): only the Fundz database page names Refactor among investors; not recorded as a round.
Hexium follow-on (~$13M, July 2025) appeared only in a search summary; Refactor participation not verified.
Inferra, Epana Bio, Macro Oceans, Vitra Labs, Atlas, Lucy and Pilgrim are on the portfolio list but no round page naming Refactor was found.
Bedrock Materials was reported in a search summary to have wound down in April 2025; not verified on a fetched page.
Portfolio count: firm and press say '100+' companies; CB Insights shows 124 investments. Portal Tela (2026-05-08) says six unicorns and 11 investments in the past year.
